title: Man's death while in police custody probed
article: Strathcona County RCMP are awaiting autopsy results to find out what caused the death of a 48-year-old man who collapsed while in police custody.
The victim has been identified as Kentucky Bruce Stephens of Strathcona County.

Police were called to the area of Township Road 520 and Range Road 214 around 6 p.m. Friday after someone reported a man acting irrationally and sitting on the road with a knife, said Const. Darren Anderson.
When police and paramedics arrived, they found the man rolling on the ground in a nearby field, flailing his arms in the air.

Three police officers approached Stephens, who didn't respond to their commands. He offered little resistance when he was restrained and handcuffed, Anderson said. The officers were walking him back to the car when he collapsed.
Paramedics gave medical attention and Stephens was rushed to hospital, where he was pronounced dead. An autopsy is scheduled for today.
